MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 1

2. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40.5
   C. 81
   D. 9

3. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 37

4. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 2

5. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x + 2

6. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 2
   D. 1

7. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 64
   C. 8
   D. 9

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 40
   C. 75
   D. 20

9. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 1/4
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/2

10. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

11. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 37
   C. 31.6
   D. 31.7

12. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 29
   C. 23
   D. 23.7

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 105
   C. 44
   D. 30

14. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 77
   B. 36
   C. 22
   D. 18

15. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 1

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 55
   C. 22
   D. 32

17. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/4

18. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.6
   C. 15
   D. 15.7

19. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 25
   C. 19
   D. 19.7

20. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 27.6

21. Solve for x: x + 6 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 6
   C. 5
   D. 11

22. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

23. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 0
   C. 16
   D. 65

24. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 170

25. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 36

26. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 27
   C. 17
   D. 31

27. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

28. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 11
   C. 28
   D. 29

29. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 50

30. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 144
